text:
Lina (CS): Need a tiny customer-facing one-pager for prefill vs on-demand for kickoff packs. keep it very short.
Marco (Solutions): Agreed. bullets + a one-liner YAML and a 3-question feedback ping.
Ivy (Eng): Add recommended defaults and a short troubleshooting curl for metrics.
Lina (CS): Draft bullets: - Prefill when prompt set is stable; TTL default 3600s. - On-demand (lazy) for varied queries; use client debounce 100-200ms. - Server batch window tradeoff: 30-80ms for low latency, 80-200ms for cost savings. - Streaming on for typing UX or >250 token responses; off for small hits.
Theo (PM): Add renewal/health signals: 30% drop in weekly active sessions -> outreach; no onboarding smoke test in 7d -> follow-up.
Marco (Solutions): One-liner YAML customers can paste:
```yaml
defaults: {prefill_ttl_s: 3600, client_debounce_ms: 150, server_batch_max_wait_ms: 50, streaming_threshold_tokens: 250}
```
Ivy (Eng): Troubleshooting curl:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/{tenant}/metrics?window=5m" | jq '.throughput, .latency_p95, .errors'
```
ops-bot: deploy/finished cs-prefill-onepager-v1 by marco at 2024-09-01T10:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
Lina (CS): Perfect. I'll add the 3-question feedback ping (day 7): "1) Relevance 1-5 2) Latency ok? y/n 3) Anything odd? (short)" and attach to kickoff email. Thanks!
